author: YOURNAME
description: Lets members pick their WoW main/secondary class, role, and spec via Discord dropdowns, kept in sync with a Google Sheet.
install_msg: Thanks for installing WowRoster! Run `[p]wowroster panel` to post the control panel, and `[p]wowroster setsheet` / `[p]wowroster setcreds` if you want Google Sheets sync.
short: WoW roster manager with dropdown UI, synced to Google Sheets
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each user's Discord ID, Discord name, and their selected WoW class/role/spec (main and secondary) locally in the bot's data folder, and optionally in a Google Sheet configured by the server's admins.
